title: Design: long category names in the picker, line and Change Prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with a long name with spaces of at least 60 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Services Preferred Pricing).
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, with a long name with no spaces of at least 60 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetServicesPreferredPricingPlan).
  • Have a new category for this test, category C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, category B and category C.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Open the Categories picker.
  5. Press Esc.
  6. Type a new value in Default's first range.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The Categories line stays on its line under the title without covering the tabs.
  • Category C shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Each category name stays inside its own row of the list; none runs past the list's edge or over the next row.
  • Checkboxes and "Now:" labels stay visible, as in picture 3.23.

Step 5:

  • The list closes.

Step 6:

  • The bar counts 1 change.

Step 7:

  • The Change Prices dialog lists each category on its own line inside the dialog, with Cancel and Change All visible.
